title.narrative: Entrepreneurship and enterprise development policies, strategies and programmes have increased access to decent jobs and incomes for women and men through micro, small and medium sized businesses

description.narrative: This initiative promotes entrepreneurship and the development of micro-, small-, and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs) in Afghanistan as a pathway to create decent jobs, sustainable livelihoods and inclusive economic growth for women and men. Implemented in collaboration with the Afghanistan Chamber of Commerce and Investment (ACCI), Afghanistan Women’s Chamber of Commerce and Industry (AWCCI), other sectoral employers’ organizations, and their provincial chapters and local partners, the programme supports the creation and growth of sustainable business enterprises through capacity building, innovation, and responsible business practices focused at enabling decent work and promoting sustainable supply chains. It includes training on entrepreneurship (both individual and collective), innovation, and business management for MSMEs to enhance their productivity; initiatives to promote job quality and employment creation in market systems and value chains through innovative and inclusive business models; and the formulation and implementation of action plans that foster decent work in selected sectors through social dialogue. The programme further supports social finance initiatives, financial literacy, and access to microfinance for MSMEs, and the development and operation of cooperatives and other common interest structures that strengthen local enterprise ecosystems. It also assists informal enterprises and self-employed workers through capacity development and tailored services to facilitate their transition to formality, thereby enhancing productivity and competitiveness. It places particular emphasis on empowering women, youth, and vulnerable groups by fostering their economic participation, leadership, and resilience, while advancing equality and inclusive enterprise growth across Afghanistan.
